table.title: [Postal traffic of China compared with some neighbouring and European countries]
table.caption_extra: Section: Chinese Posts. As an indication of the responsibilities the Chinese Post Office will have to undertake in the future, the following table giving figures relating to China and some neighbouring and European countries is instructive:— (introduced at foot of p. 453)
transcriber_notes: Thousands separators are printed inconsistently (many appear as full stops, e.g. '340.000.000', because of broken type); all thousands separators are written here as commas. Decimal points in the Average column are genuine.
',,' (ditto, = 1918) printed in Year column for Japan, India, Indo-China; kept as printed.
China, Newspapers and Printed Matter: second digit broken ('2?2,127,672') — left blank. Printed Total minus the other parts would imply 202,127,672.

Great Britain, Newspapers and Printed Matter: read '1,457,5?8,000', the tens-of-thousands... digit after 5 is broken (8 or 9?) — left blank. Printed Total minus other parts would imply 1,457,588,030 (not a round figure, so the printed total does not reconcile exactly with any reading ending ,000).
France, Newspapers and Printed Matter: read '1,3?5,351,558', second digit broken (5 or 6) — left blank.
France, Free Correspondence: read '12?,926,000', third digit broken (probably 0) — left blank.
France, Total: first digit broken (3 or 5?) — left blank; rest reads ',078,599,697'.

Switzerland, Total: read '3?0,286,743' with the second digit broken (appears to be 9) — left blank. Note parts (letters+postcards+newspapers+free) sum to 651,791,016, and 651,791,016/3,753,293 = 173.7, close to the printed Average 173.5, so the printed total (if 390,286,743) would not reconcile.
Japan: parts sum to 2,497,489,507 — reconciles. India: parts sum to 1,132,529,429 — reconciles.
Indo-China: parts sum to 20,499,635 vs printed Total 20,499,035 — does NOT reconcile (diff 600); cells re-read, '1,826,314' has a damaged 6.
Strait Settlements: parts sum to 9,119,145 vs printed Total 9,119,146 — does NOT reconcile (diff 1); '596,358' has a damaged 5/8.
Average appears to be total articles per head of population.
